title: Machine composition across an exit state
statement: Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be deterministic Turing machines with the same input alphabet and number of work tapes, with state sets $S_1$ and $S_2$. Given an exit state $e\in S_1$ and an entry state $b\in S_2$, form a machine with state set $S_1\sqcup S_2$ that starts in the initial state of $M_1$. In a state from $S_1$ other than $e$, it performs the transition of $M_1$, retaining its input movement, work-tape actions, and output, and places any successor state in the $S_1$ summand. At $e$, it leaves the input and work tapes in place, emits nothing, and enters $b$ in the $S_2$ summand; in the $S_2$ summand it performs $M_2$'s transitions with successor states placed in that summand.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
Machines $M_1$ and $M_2$ over a common symbol alphabet
